notes.title: Demo version, new help manual, many fixes and minor additions
notes.notes:
We have released a demo version of the app which has all the functionality but with time limits. That means you can test all features (and whether it works with your setup at all) before deciding if you want to buy it. It includes a new help manual with a lot of answers for frequent questions, as well as videos and GIFs. We have also fixed a lot of stuff and added minor features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/3830211aa13008f0e8ab30d9beb6f5221e56008e.gif[/img]

List of changes:
[list][*]Demo version
[*]New help manual inside app
[*]Possibility of enabling or disabling specific trackers as body tracker for hands mode (this fixes e.g. LIV)
[*]Fixed "Restart SteamVR" buttons
[*]Fixed opening URLs
[*]Fixed missing fonts
[*]Fixed Vive Cosmos Elite. Thanks to Oscar (Knoob2001) of Real o Virtual for helping us to analyze the issue with his Vive Cosmos.
[*]Add "invert" option to "tilt head to strafe" feature
[*]Add camera hack option for fixing Vive/Index cameras
[*]Add "press grip of opposite controller" to sprint, needed for some Skyrim VR mods
[*]Add code to copy & paste in support messages to allow us to diagnose issues much quicker
[*]Fixed body direction joystick remapping (available with "combine with movement")
[*]Added a message recommending T-pose or Y-pose for a quick calibration
[/list]

notes.title: 3rd anniversary update: Hip direction for hands mode, Y-pose calibration, & more
notes.notes:
We released Natural Locomotion on Sunday, 8th of April of 2018 with just Vive support, a very basic hands mode and a few profiles. Looking back the application has grown a lot thanks to the support of a wonderful community that allowed us to continue the development. For this update we have only a few changes but we hope you like them.

We would like to announce we are working with Decagear team to add support to Decamove as an official Natural Locomotion tracker!
[url=https://twitter.com/MyouSoftware/status/1374050496680452097]We received one a few days ago.[/url]

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list][*]Hip direction for hands mode: You can now move in the direction of your body in hands mode, with a smartphone in the pocket or with a Vive tracker on the waist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/9ad41165ce73114fff3f6b67db854035d4f6547a.png[/img]

[*]T-pose to calibrate direction quickly can now be disabled, or switched to Y-pose because the T-pose conflicted with a gesture in Population: One.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/778c07342594b9033319c5f419bc2a46e55cb228.png[/img]

[*]Some profiles now have a screenshot of the settings. Click them to expand. We will continue adding screenshots for all the profiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/d181c0b71ea200d9b31726b88aca8ef17db48709.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes and improvements[/h1]

[list][*]Fitness stats now makes it more obvious that it's a button that can be switched from "session" to "profile" and "global".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/7f2eab05c68323cf655916766589c6dff88278a6.gif[/img]

[*]Fixed some WMR headsets jumping all the time.
[*]Fixed foot tracker icons, it was showing generic ones instead.
[*]Miscellaneous UI changes.
[*]Added and modified some profiles.
[/list]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list][*]Introduced some changes required for the [url=https://twitter.com/MyouSoftware/status/1371623584523771904]iPhone version of NaLo tracker[/url] (it's finished and will be published soon).
[*]Introduced some changes to pave the way for Decamove support
[*]Reworked store page to better reflect all Natural Locomotion features
[/list]

[h1]This is what we have achieved in Natural Locomotion in the last 3 years!
[/h1]

[h2]Hands Mode[/h2]
Slowly swing your hand controllers to walk or move them fast to run. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/cb4456b2d5eac8b9958c0031f1dcdf57ee75b4a6.png[/img]

Other "arm swinger" implementations are very "jumpy", very slow to respond, or are a complement on button actions. Natural Locomotion uses a novel system designed to walk and run continuously, and with very precise and intuitive control of speed and acceleration. You can start, stop or change speed very quickly without "move" or "brake" buttons, it just depends on the speed you move your arms.

[h3]Buttonless activator based on gestures[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/3759b91d6d2580d7792edce376a907f5c19e9ec1.png[/img]

[h3]Hip direction for hands mode[/h3]
As we have announced today, hands mode is now compatible with body trackers (Smartphones and trackers). Using a body tracker, the direction of the movement depends on where your hip is oriented which could make this locomotion method even more immersive and comfortable. 

[h2] Feet Mode [/h2]
Use motion sensor devices (see the list below) attached in your feet to register your feet movements and walk in the game. It supports two kind of movements: Walk-in-place and swinging feet while sitting on a chair or using a treadmill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/929fe62a5b4a00c4e67a6861c1303bc6c80b7b9a.png[/img]

[h3]Supported (tested) headsets[/h3]
[list][*]HTC Vive / Pro / Cosmos / Cosmos Elite
[*]Oculus Rift / Rift S / Quest (1 and 2, through Oculus Link or Virtual Desktop)
[*]Windows Mixed Reality and HP Reverb G2
[*]Valve Index
[*]Pimax
[*]HTC Vive Cosmos
[*]Pico Neo 2 and Pico Neo 2 EYE
[/list]

[h3]Supported VR controllers:[/h3]
[list][*]HTC Vive wands
[*]Oculus touch
[*]Windows Mixed Reality (with trackpad)
[*]Valve Index
[*]HP Reverb G2
[*]HTC Vive Cosmos
[*]Pico Neo 2 6DoF controllers
[/list]

[h3]Supported devices (for feet mode)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/64d15e5f488defc54caebee851e184f35ea86322.png[/img]

[list][*]HTC Vive trackers (Dongles included)
[*]Any SteamVR controller converted to tracker
[*]Original Nintendo Switch JoyCon 
[*]PS3 Move controllers (No camera required)
[*]Smartphone with Android >= 5.1, with accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer (compass).
[url]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.myousoftware.nalo_device[/url]
[/list]

[h2] SteamVR Tools [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/70523bff78b8f2aa3550d5643a81e969ded724f5.png[/img]

[h3]Align VR spaces of different tracking systems[/h3]
Combine lighthouse devices (Trackers, HTC Vive controllers or Index controllers) with Oculus, WMR or Vive Cosmos headsets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/c0254d2ad5886a98d07fa47ae5300416674f39b3.gif[/img]

[h3]Convert some SteamVR controllers into trackers[/h3]
This tool will temporarily emulate HTC Vive trackers using other lighthouse devices (And Oculus CV1 controllers) without flashing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/79428a3a5f182d88273a47921c2286e285bcedf5.png[/img]

[h3]Convert Steam Controller dongles to Vive/Index dongles[/h3]
This utility allows you to convert Steam Controller dongles into Vive/Valve controller/tracker dongles (and restore them).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/9f3d6b2fbc4d8790d74c2fc7438a2118ce24101a.gif[/img]

You need one dongle per device. A Vive or Index headset has two of them built in. For example if you have 4 controllers and an Index/Vive headset (only USB and power connected), you only have 2 receptors and you need 2 dongles to use all controllers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32383436/962735a3a70b5ec801e3eebb7a436afa471bbf26.png[/img]

[h2]Profiles[/h2]
The past 3 years we added profiles for 88 games, which could not be very impressive, but if you count the different profiles for each controller type this number jumps to 476 (not counting Revive profiles).

notes.title: Driver updated to fix SteamVR crash, new NaLo nearing a beta release
notes.notes:
We have released a new driver for the new SteamVR version released yesterday. It's a temporary patch since we made a workaround that might have performance problems in very old CPUs. If any of you experience low performance, the new version (in development) should fix them.

If you experience crashes, the driver may not be properly updated. Follow these steps to ensure it's up to date:[list]
[*] Close SteamVR.
[*] Reinstall Natural Locomotion. (alternatively you can use "verify integrity of game files")
[*] Open Natural Locomotion [u][b]without[/b][/u] opening SteamVR first.
[*] You only need to follow these steps once. After that you can open it in whichever order you prefer.
[/list]
We have rewritten the driver and most parts of NaLo which allow us to release new features we couldn't before due to technical debt. Some of these features will include:[list]
[*]Overlay
[*]Detect game to auto start profiles
[*]Universal support for any SteamVR headset without explicit support on our side
[*]Buttonless setting for hands mode (Walking gesture will only be registered e.g. when the hands are under a certain height)
[*]Better performance
[*]Night mode theme
[*]OpenComposite support
[*]iOS version of NaLo tracker
[*]Gamepad emulation
[*]Demo version with all features to use in games
[/list]
We don't have a release date for this new version yet but we'll publish a beta version as soon as we fix some critical bugs. This beta will have the first 6 features listed above.

We have also removed the old demo since it was giving too many problems with modern headsets and one couldn't try the feet tracker mode or whether it works with your games.

notes.title: Feet [v3 Beta] patch notes.
notes.notes:
Thank you community! We are listening all your bug reports and suggestions. I couldn't be possible without you.

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed Left/Right controller detection in HTC Vive pro headset with Valve Index Controllers.[/b] It should fix the locomotion not working issue recently reported by some users in the forum.
[*] [b]Fixed walking backwards by leaning back calibration.[/b] NaLo was not detecting the neck position correctly. 
This issue could produce walking backwards by default in some cases reported in the forum.
[*] [b]Fixed a rare case where some trackers would appear duplicated in Natural Locomotion.[/b] This is not the same than duplicated controllers in the "Convert SteamVR controller to tracker" UI.
[/list]

notes.title: More bug fixes
notes.notes:
After releasing the last update we found a few more bugs. Thanks for the community to notify them so quickly!
[list]
[*] Fixed passthrough remap for joystick/trackpad touch activator.
[*] Increased joystick/trackpad touch filter speed. It will block accidental touches only when you move your arm faster than 4 m/s.
[*] Fixed sprint in Skyrim (and in other games with similar sprint behaviour): Stop wasting stamina while walking after sprinting.
[*] Fixed many bugs related to renaming profiles.
[/list]

notes.title: Update with BONEWORKS profile and some bug fixes
notes.notes:
We're not dead. We're making a much better version of Natural Locomotion. Since it's taking too long, we'll keep updating the current one.

List of changes:
[list][*]Fixed left/right detection of vive controllers on index HMD.
[*]Fixed jump function working unreliably after a few jumps.
[*]Fixed neck model on Index, Rift, WMR.
[*]Fixed driver bug where some trackers couldn't have the role configured.
[*]Removed demo (for now, we're working on a new one).
[*]Added BONEWORKS profile for all headsets except WMR.
[*]Added Zero Caliber to Index that was missing by mistake.
[*]Added profile for No Man's Sky (But it requires the hands to be slightly lifted for now).
[/list]
Main planned features for the upcoming Natural Locomotion version (no release date yet):
[i][list][*]Workshop for profiles.
[*]UI in VR overlay.
[*]Detection of running game to enable desired profile automatically.
[*]Vive Cosmos support (and any other SteamVR headset, automatically).
[*]Native Oculus SDK support.
[/list][/i]
It will be a free update to all Natural Locomotion users.

notes.title: Added Minecraft (Vivecraft), The Forest, In Death, Arizona Sunshine (WMR), improved FO4VR on Rift, Dead Effect 2, and other changes
notes.notes:
List of changes:
[list]
[*]Profiles for The Forest VR beta hotfix 2.
[*]Profiles for [url=http://www.vivecraft.org/]Vivecraft[/url] 1.12.x (not tested with previous versions). It doesn't run automatically yet.
[*]Profile for In Death (for Vive and WMR).
[*]Profile for Arizona Sunshine for WMR (already available for others).
[*]Improvements to Fallout 4 VR on Rift after the beta went stable.
[*]Improved Dead Effect 2 profiles by adding smoothing compensation.
[*]Fixed Dead Effect 2 issues with VIve.
[*]Added joystick walk, jump with a specific trackpad click direction, smoothing compensation, among other details for The Forest.
[*]Enlarged sliders of "describe original locomotion".
[*]If SteamVR was expecting an app, it will wait 60 seconds since startup before opening a game (workaround, this will be properly fixed).
[*]Many internal changes in preparation to add walk in place.
[/list]
We're working hard to bring Walk In Place and more movement alternatives to Natural Locomotion, and many more features and profiles. If you want to help speed up development, please tell your friends about Natural Locomotion!

Shout-out to [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Vive]/r/Vive[/url] for their support!

As always, report any issues, suggestions or requests in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798810/discussions]community forum[/url].

notes.title: Updated Skyrim VR profile for the new version of the game
notes.notes:
A couple of days ago Skyrim VR beta was promoted as the regular version for everybody. We deprecated the beta profile and changed the regular one to be as the beta. As a reminder, the only change is the original orientation: It explains to use HMD mode, which works better for sprinting. [b]Don't forget to configure your game to be HMD oriented![/b]

As usual, head to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798810/discussions/]community forum[/url] if you have any problem or suggestion.

We're still working on new features. We'll publish each one in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798810/discussions/0/1694919808758692185/]beta thread[/url] as soon as possible. Subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/798810/discussions/0/1694919808758692185/]that thread[/url] for updates.
